parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Xavier invests $500 at a rate of 1.5% per year simple interest. At the end of y years, the value of Xavier’s investment is $612.50 . Find the value of y . y = ................................................ [3]

content.tex: Xavier invests \(\$500\) at a rate of \(1.5\%\) per year simple interest. At the end of \(y\) years, the value of Xavier’s investment is \(\$612.50\) .

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Each year the value of a car decreases by 12% of its value at the beginning of that year. The original value of the car is $20 000.

content.tex: Each year the value of a car decreases by \(12\%\) of its value at the beginning of that year. The original value of the car is \(\$20000.\)

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Calculate the value of the car at the end of 3 years. Give your answer correct to the nearest dollar. $ ................................................ [3]

content.tex: Calculate the value of the car at the end of 3 years. Give your answer correct to the nearest dollar.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Find the number of complete years for the value of $20 000 to decrease until it is first below $1000. ................................................. [4]

content.tex: Find the number of complete years for the value of \(\$20000\) to decrease until it is first below \(\$1000.\)

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) Each year the value of another car decreases by r % of its value at the beginning of that year. At the end of 10 years, the value has decreased from $12 000 to $4673. Find the value of r . r = ................................................ [3]

content.tex: Each year the value of another car decreases by \(r\%\) of its value at the beginning of that year. At the end of 10 years, the value has decreased from \(\$12000\) to \(\$4673.\)
